articles.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
articles.summary: Opus 5 is a step change improvement for the Opus tier powering long-running agents while delivering improvements in coding and professional work.

articles.title: Project Pilot: Can AI models fly drones?
articles.summary: We worked with Andon Labs on Drone-Bench, a new benchmark testing whether AI models can autonomously fly a drone to locate and follow a person.

articles.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
articles.summary: Health in ChatGPT now lets eligible U.S. users securely connect medical records and Apple Health to get more personalized insights and better understand their health.

articles.title: Supporting ambitious external research through the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund
